Backstab damage stacks higher than most expect - an extra weapon die plus additional dice equal to half.

GMs: Remind players that Backstab adds one weapon die plus half-level dice, rounded down, to avoid damage disputes.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Coiling Grasp Tattoo's real surprise is its ongoing damage - 3d6 force damage at the start of each of your.

DMs: Remind players to maintain concentration on the grapple for that sweet 3d6 force damage every round.

Spellburn seems like free power - but it permanently burns Strength, Agility, or Stamina.

Judges: Show them how burning 3 Strength for a spell check can turn a wizard into easy prey for the next goblin.

Dungeon kit spotlight: The Bonus Doesn't Stack.

DMs: Enforce that the Proficiency Bonus can't stack; one bonus per roll, then move on.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Dwarf's infravision is longer than most expect - 60 feet in total darkness.

Judges: Remind your Dwarf to body-block for the +2 AC Shield Brother bonus; it's not just for decoration.

Seer shifts from support to pressure - Destined and Omen talents enable this pivot with 1d6 bonus rolls.

GMs: Remind Seers to use Destined's 1d6 bonus when a DC 9 Wisdom check succeeds, shifting from support to pressure.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Detect Poison and Disease shifts the tactical landscape - Concentration for up to 10 minutes reveals threats.

DMs: Cast Detect Poison and Disease as a ritual before entering unknown areas to reveal threats without wasting a spell slot.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Run Athasi for stakes, not flavor.

Judges: Prioritize disrupting Athasi's charm person spell to prevent your party from turning against itself.

Restoration changes the game more than expected - one curse or illness ends instantly.

GMs: Save Restoration for when a curse or illness is the only thing stopping the party from moving forward.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Druid's spellcasting punishes poor positioning - Multiattack and area spells exploit clustering.

DMs: Punish clustering by casting Thunderwave; its 15-foot cube and 44 HP will remind them why spacing matters.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Medusa's Touch Blade can end a fight with one hit - Fort save DC is 1d10+10.

Judges: Wait for a high roll on the 1d10+10 DC before swinging Medusa's Touch Blade to maximize its petrifying potential.

Morale isn't just a flavor rule - it triggers on a DC 15 WIS check when half the monsters fall.

GMs: When half the monsters fall, roll that DC 15 Wisdom check for morale or expect endless, tedious combat.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.
